risks.risk: Tire size is unknown, so the buyer may not be able to fit it to their vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the size (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown-size used tire (worst-case fit risk).

risks.risk: Age/DOT date is unknown; older tires can fail sooner even if tread looks good.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tires (worst-case age).

risks.risk: Tread depth/remaining life is not measured; 'almost like new' may be overstated.
risks.proof: A photo of tread depth gauge readings (or a clear ruler measurement) at multiple points.

risks.risk: Damage/repairs (sidewall cuts, patches, bulges) are not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls and the full circumference, including any bulges/repairs.

risks.risk: Quantity/number of tires is unclear (photos show at least two, but not confirmed).
risks.proof: Confirm how many tires are included in the order and show all tires in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per the visible set only (worst-case: fewer tires than expected).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall photo showing full tire size (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed rating.
Tread depth measurement at 3–4 points (photo with gauge/ruler).
Full sidewall + full tread circumference photos to check for cuts, patches, and bulges.
Confirm the exact number of tires included in the sale.
